dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, and a repeated-field help example are implemented; focused tests pass.

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name matching is case-insensitive; canonical selected fields supply headers; candidate-rich unknown and sorted ambiguous errors are reachable.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The initial field page is reused, extra pages are fetched only when indicated, and pagination errors return before rendering.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: Reachable type switch renders every specified scalar, structured, and multi-value type; missing/unknown values are empty and line breaks are normalized.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers and ID-matched cells are appended for every item, including empty cells, through the existing runList table path.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Validation and resolution occur before table output; retrieval errors propagate. The focused diff uses existing query, command, and table helpers without altering unselected behavior.
